item.title: Mumbai City FC Unveil New Club Crest
item.description: Mumbai, 14 July 2023: Mumbai City Football Club have today unveiled the club’s new crest ahead of the 2023-24 season, a landmark 10th season of the club’s history. The new crest was presented to its supporters, players and the Indian football community at an event in Mumbai.The new Mumbai City FC crest draws its inspiration from the club’s first crest and the important values of Mumbai that it represented along with the city’s modernity and pioneering spirit. item.title: Mumbai City FC Welcomes Petr Kratky As New Head Coach
item.description: Mumbai City is delighted to announce the arrival of Petr Kratky as the Club’s new Head Coach. item.title: Shenzhen Peng City Football Club hosts launch event in front of fans and unveils new Club crest
item.description: Shenzhen, China, February 27, 2024 – Shenzhen Peng City Football Club today hosted a launch event ahead of the 2023-24 Chinese Super League season. The Club’s new crest, full squad and 2024 ticketing programme were presented to its supporters, media and the Shenzhen football community at the in-person celebratory event. The newly launched Club crest is based on a circular layout, consistent with many of City Football Group’s sister clubs, including Manchester City, New York City and Mumbai City.

item.title: City Football Group and Oak View Group launch Eastlands Venue Services joint venture
item.description: City Football Group (CFG) and Oak View Group (OVG) have today announced the launch of Eastlands Venue Services, a new joint venture to create a fully integrated service and operations company.
